selection_rule: Speech-level draw from corpus.load()'s unique doc_names. 30-year era bins anchored at 1789 (bin 0 = 1789-1818). Proportional 25% per bin, rounded half up (int(fraction*n + 0.5)) and clamped to [3, bin_size]. Within each bin the doc_names are SORTED before a seeded numpy.random.default_rng(20260721) draw, so the selection reproduces bit-for-bit. The committed JSON — not the seed — is the source of truth for every downstream run (including a future hand-graded truth pass).
